issues.detail: The Greek 'καθως δεδοκιμασμεθα' (kathōs dedokimasthētha) is a passive construction meaning 'as we are being tested/tried.' The Vietnamese translation 'đã thử nghiệm chúng tôi' (has tested us) renders it as a completed action by God, whereas the Greek implies an ongoing state or condition of being under test. Furthermore, the Greek structure 'καθως... ουτως' (as... so) indicates a proportional comparison ('just as we are tested... so we speak'), which is slightly flattened in the Vietnamese 'vì... nên' (because... therefore) construction.
